result:
If I could change just one thing, I would give everyone the ability to *truly* understand each other.

Not just hearing words, but actually feeling for a moment what it's like to be the other person — their fears, their hopes, what shaped them, what they're trying to protect.

I think almost all of our biggest problems come from a failure of that. Wars, cruelty, polarization, even neglect of the planet — it happens when other people feel abstract and far away. And a lot of our private pain — loneliness, shame, grief — comes from feeling not understood ourselves.

If empathy was visceral and automatic, I don't think we'd need to force most other changes. People who feel secure and understood don't need to dominate. People who can feel each other's experience naturally want to be kinder, cooperate more, think longer-term.

So not superpowers or infinite money — just a world where no one feels invisible, and no one can pretend other people are invisible either. I think everything else — justice, sustainability, kindness — would flow from that.

What would you change?
